interface.scenario: UIREQ-023 scenario 2 (Midnight end-to-end qualification on the selected target network); scenario 1 keeps its --native-inventory interface
interface.network: selected by `qa/holdout/run.sh uireq-023 --network NET`, else DW_HOLDOUT_NETWORK, else default_network; NET is one of qa/holdout/config/networks.json `selectable` (undeployed, preview, mainnet). stagenet is retired and refused. preview and mainnet qualify; undeployed (local Docker at ledger 9.1.0.1) is a rehearsal: every check runs, and a fully passing rehearsal still exits 1 with 'REHEARSAL OK', because a local chain is not a Midnight target qualification. All records listed for the selected network are checked and must all pass; the case sets the minimum count (preview 3: fact, list123, P3).
interface.record: committed JSON {format:'moriarty-sherlock-native-qualification/2', source:{path (committed draft .mori with a closed entry), sha256}, pins:{network (the selected network), genesis_hash ('0x' + 64 hex; equal to the sealed genesis of preview/mainnet), ledger_version:'9.1.0.1', node_version, toolchain, relation_id (sha256 of relation_vk_path bytes), relation_vk_path (committed Midnight 'midnight:verifier-key[vN]:' file of the called circuit), state_layout_path (committed compiled ledger layout), state_layout_sha256}, stages:{compile:{status}, prove:{status, prover}, verify:{status, verifier (not the prover)}, deploy:{status, tx (64-hex indexer hash of the ContractDeploy), address}, call:{status, tx, entry_point}, readback:{status, state_sha256 (sha256 of the indexed post-call state bytes), observed_result (optional; must equal the decoded value), effects: []}}, claims:{execution_authority:'none', preview_fenrir_evidence_transferred:false, stagenet_evidence_transferred:false}}; every stage status is 'run' or 'not-run'. Records of one network have distinct sources and distinct call transactions.
interface.holdout: recomputes the source, relation and layout hashes; requires all six stages run (else SPEC GATE); reads the selected network's public indexer only (preview: indexer.preview.midnight.network; mainnet: Blockfrost, project id from DW_BLOCKFROST_MAINNET_PROJECT_ID, absent means host unfit; undeployed: 127.0.0.1:8088 or DW_UNDEPLOYED_INDEXER); requires the deploy tx to be the indexed ContractDeploy of the address and the call tx a distinct indexed ContractCall there with the recorded entry point; requires the pinned verifying key body (after its 'midnight:verifier-key[vN]:' header) to occur exactly once in the deploy and post-call states, at most 64 bytes after the entry point name (relation installed for that entry); DECODES the result from the indexed state bytes through the committed layout: the deploy-state value must equal layout.initial, the post-call value must equal the holdout's own mori simulate reference result of the committed source, and the two must differ; the record's observed_result is never trusted
interface.state_layout: {format:'moriarty-sherlock-state-layout/2', result:{offset:int (byte offset into the indexed contract state of the result atom's length prefix), encoding:'u128-be-trimmed', length_prefix:'u8'|'scale-compact', initial:'<decimal value in the deploy state>'}}. The ledger stores acceptRun's canonical big-endian Bytes<16> result with trailing zero bytes trimmed (SRC-007): a one-byte prefix gives the stored length L (u8: the byte is L; scale-compact: the byte is L << 2), L <= 16, followed by L bytes that are the first L bytes of the 16-byte big-endian value; the decoder pads them with zeros to 16 bytes. Canonical form is required: L == 0 exactly for the value 0, otherwise the last stored byte is nonzero. This decodes the whole u128 domain (0, 1, 256, 2^64, u128::MAX); there is no nonzero-low-byte restriction. The fixed 16-byte windows 'u128-le'/'u128-be' of layout/1 are refused for every selectable network.
interface.evaluator_note: Evaluator-authored (sherlock-eval 2026-10-25). No wallet is opened by the holdout; an unreachable indexer is host-unfit (exit 3). CONTRACT CHANGE 2026-10-26 (quint-3 finding via sherlock-fable): the readback result is decoded from the indexed state, and the on-chain verifying key is bound to the pinned relation. CONTRACT CHANGE 2026-11-08 (E12, task 1.4; owner decision 2026-11-08: Mainnet target, Preview test network, stagenet retired): qualification_record (one stagenet record) became qualification_records per network with default_network preview; record format /2 pins network, genesis_hash and ledger_version 9.1.0.1 and adds claims.stagenet_evidence_transferred:false; layout format /2 decodes the ledger's trimmed big-endian result over the whole u128 domain (SRC-007) and replaces the fixed windows.
